main_text.p: celebrata fiunt omnium Miniftrorum erroribus, tum infirmitatibus plærunque & perturbationibus, tum judicii & eloquentiæ mancamentis obnoxia.

Quæ incommoda neceffarió fequuntu-ra diverfos Celebrandi modos, cùm vehe-menter ferió perpenderet fapientia & pietas Antiquarum Ecclefiarum, occa-fionem hinc arripuerunt (quâ mede-rentur huic malo) instituendi perpetuas Liturgias, eafque publicè priùs compo-nendas.

Quarum defectum aliquando sentiet (credo) hæc Ecclesia, cùm effrenis in posterum ignorantiæ, & imbecillium in-geniorum præsidentiæ fructus indies ca-lamitosi, in omne genus erroribus, confusionibus, Schismatis, & alienis charitate dif-fidiis, (quæ jam nimis malo nostro experti fuimus) magis magisque detegentur.

Sin vero ita obstinati sint, (ne omninò nil agere videantur) has suas Novitates invehere, quas & Lex & Ratio & Religio prohibet, (saltim ita per vim obtrudi, ut Liturgia publica extrudatur) nullo tamen colore excusatur iniquissima horum hominum feveritas, qui (cum Ipsi non ita pridem, pars maxima subsigna-rent, usurparent quoque hunc Librum, & asserent, vel, qui id recusarant, ve-hemen-

page.notes: Running head is Greek and kept in Greek letters. Long s read as plain s throughout. A stray apostrophe after "fidiis," was not transcribed as text. The page ends at the line "hemen-", the word continues on the next page. Italic and roman type judged from the scan at "Celebrandi" (roman) and "modos" (italic), which is uncertain.
